summaries.summary: This class models the HPX Printer Details screen in a mobile application. It extends SmartFlow and provides comprehensive automation methods for interacting with various printer-related features including scanning, printing, copying, faxing, and accessing printer information. The class contains methods for navigating through tiles (camera scan, print photos, shortcuts, scan, print documents, copy, mobile fax, printables, print quality tools), managing printer information (product number, serial number, general info, network info, reports), and handling various printer operations. Most methods include swipe functionality to locate elements that may not be immediately visible on the screen, with configurable timeout and error handling parameters.
